en.title: Manchester City found guilty of breaking Premier League's financial fair play rules
en.summary: An independent panel found Manchester City guilty on nearly all of over 100 charges related to financial fair play rule breaches. The club faces substantial sanctions and has indicated it plans to appeal the verdict.

stories.title: Police watchdog says Met should investigate itself over arrest of 'Putney pusher' suspect

en.title: Police watchdog says Met should investigate itself over arrest of 'Putney pusher' suspect
en.summary: A police watchdog has recommended that the Metropolitan Police conduct an internal investigation into its handling of a suspect in the 'Putney pusher' case. The 44-year-old suspect was found dead at his home while under investigation.

en.title: Met should probe handling of 'Putney Pusher' case, police watchdog says
en.summary: A police watchdog has recommended the Metropolitan Police investigate its handling of the 'Putney Pusher' case. The suspect's family attributes his death to stress caused by the police investigation.
